_note: PLA-673 sense-guard match spec in the RULED glossary shape (2026-10-05): each term's `match` is a list holding one matcher object with sense, forms, crops, refuse_on and exclusions. These `match` lists land verbatim as glossary.<term>.match; the entry keeps only its seven ruled keys. Read by tools/glossary_sense.py. Semantics: (1) exclusions consume their span first and tag it `none` (both terms carry the IDENTICAL exclusion list, so exclusion-first holds whichever term a reader starts from; the guard refuses if they differ); (2) a remaining hill-word is tagged by the ONE term whose `crops` holds the crop, if its form is in `forms` and no `refuse_on` pattern matches its sentence; (3) anything else is UNCLASSIFIED and the guard refuses.

match.sense: planting in hills: a small group of seeds sown together in one spot (some guides raise it into a low mound)

exclusions.why: cultivar synonym named for Madalene Hill
place: Texas Hill Country (both cases occur)
landform: Hawaii upland elevation (citrus, snow peas)
strawberry planting system (matted row vs hill system / plasticulture annual-hill)
black/purple raspberry 'hill' = the cane clump from one crown (UMN 2e413287: 'the "hill" is not made by mounding the soil')

match.sense: hilling: drawing soil or compost up around growing plants (potato, root crops, alliums, corn, brussels sprouts); includes potato's noun `hill` for the hilled mound
